banking-economy.title: NCLT approves merger of Jana Holdings with Jana Capital
banking-economy.summary: NCLT approved the amalgamation of Jana Holdings Ltd with Jana Capital Ltd effective November 3, 2026. Both companies belong to the promoter group of Jana Small Finance Bank Limited. The amalgamation aims to eliminate the Non-Operative Financial Holding Company layer while ensuring a seamless transition of assets and liabilities. Jana Holdings was established in January 2017 for regulatory compliance and will be dissolved post-merger.
